column1: # Existing installed Fedora 44 / Plasma 6.7.4 VM; app and style RPMs only.

column2: Recommended shows three real products with readable descriptions and named actions.
Search finds a non-recommended app; empty state is readable and clearing restores results.
Details stay in the main window; Back restores the search and list position.
Changing category then switching views does not silently filter Recommended or Installed.
Tab focus is visible and Space opens details from a product identity button.
Light palette retains readable text and distinct focus.
Larger text and a narrow window wrap descriptions without losing actions.
Start Here shows two primary choices and settings, updates, shortcuts and help.
A whole guide row works by pointer and keyboard; shortcuts include Meta+S.
Appearance remains readable with the revised shared widget style.
